request.spec:
A paste box takes lines of name,amount,date,note (the note may hold commas; the date may be
blank for the sheet's today; the note may be absent) and adds a DRAFT claim per line, in order,
for the named person (the name must be on the sheet, matched as names are compared). Every line is
checked first with exactly the claim form's rules: if any line fails, an error shows on the box
and nothing is added; otherwise every claim is added and written as CLAIM_ADDED. Show how many
were added.

agent.result_text:
The paste box is in and working: `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**How it works**
- **The box:** a new panel just below the quick-add bar has a text area, a Paste button and an "Added:" count. The count clears when you press Paste and shows the new number once the claims are in. Any refusal shows an error on the box, and typing in the box removes it.
- **New endpoint:** `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/claims/paste` checks every line before it adds anything:
  - The name must belong to someone on the sheet. Case and surrounding spaces don't matter, the same way quick-add finds people.
  - The amount, date and note go through the same validation the claim form uses. I pulled that check out of `ValidateClaim` into a shared function, so the form and the paste box can't drift apart.
  - A line is refused if its date (or the sheet's today, when the date is blank) is in a closed period or after the person retired.

  If every line passes, it adds the DRAFT claims in order, writes one `CLAIM_ADDED` per claim, then runs the usual rollup audit. If any line fails, nothing is stored and nothing is written to the audit file.
- **Errors** name the line that failed, e.g. "Line 2: no person Zed on this sheet."

**Choices I made that the request didn't settle**
- Blank lines are skipped, so a trailing newline is harmless. A paste with no lines at all is refused.
- A line with only `name,amount` is accepted, and its date is the sheet's today.
- A negative amount is always refused, because a paste line has no field to say which claim it corrects. That is what the claim form does when that field is left empty.
- The text area empties after a paste goes through.

The server code is in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/claim/` (`ValidatePaste`, `AddPastedClaims`, `RespondWithPasted` and small records), wired by `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/sheets/{sheetId}/claims/paste.POST.yml`. The front end is `src/main/frontend/features/paste/paste.slot.tsx`.
